title: Yeasty Crumbly Northern Thai Yogurt Wrap
description: A crispy, slightly sweet, and savory Northern Thai dish featuring a yeasty, crumbly dough, served in a halal-friendly ssam wrap with a dollop of yogurt on a hot stone plate.
instructions: Combine yeast and flour in a large mixing bowl. Mix until a sticky dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes elastic and smooth.
Let the dough rest in a warm place for 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size.
Heat the coconut oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the palm sugar and cook until caramelized.
Add the ginger paste and hot pepper to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
Place the dough on a floured surface and roll it out thinly.
Cut the dough into small squares, about 3 inches per side.
Heat a hot stone plate in a dry pan over medium heat.
Cook the dough squares on the hot stone plate for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
Serve the crispy dough squares in a ssam wrap with a dollop of yogurt, a sprinkle of cilantro leaves, and a squeeze of lime juice.
Garnish with additional cilantro leaves and serve immediately.
